title: Review: stoa-526bc4c6 CredentialStore merge
notes:

The main gap is the builder logic (secretx handling) duplicated in 3 places with smtp not updated to match the new pattern. No security exposure from this inconsistency, but operational inconsistency risk if divergence accumulates.

Would raise confidence if: full smtp/server.rs audit run. No safety issues; the main gap is the builder duplication.
